# ash_rate_limiter v2.0.0 - Table of Contents

Rate limit your Ash actions

## Pages

- [README](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Change Log](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [AshRateLimiter](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashratelimiter.md)

## Modules

- [AshRateLimiter](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.md): An extension for `Ash.Resource` which adds the ability to rate limit access to actions.

- [AshRateLimiter.Backend](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.Backend.md): A behaviour for rate limiting backends.
- [AshRateLimiter.BuiltinChanges](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.BuiltinChanges.md): Change helpers to allow direct usage in mutation actions.

- [AshRateLimiter.BuiltinPreparations](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.BuiltinPreparations.md): Preparation helpers to allow direct usage in read actions.

- [AshRateLimiter.Change](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.Change.md): A resource change which implements rate limiting.

- [AshRateLimiter.Info](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.Info.md): Auto-generated introspection functions.

- [AshRateLimiter.Preparation](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.Preparation.md): A resource preparation which implements rate limiting.
- [AshRateLimiter.Transformer](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.Transformer.md): A Spark DSL transformer for rate limiting.

- Exceptions
  - [AshRateLimiter.LimitExceeded](https://ash-rate-limiter.hexdocs.pm/AshRateLimiter.LimitExceeded.md): An exception which is raised or returned when an action invocation exceeds the defined limits.
